2609.16847.title: RegRet: Enhancing Region-Level Retrieval in Large Multimodal Models
2609.16847.paper_summary: Region-level retrieval aims to align user-specified image regions with relevant regions or textual descriptions, playing a crucial role in realworld applications such as e-commerce product search and RAG. Although recent Large Multimodal Models (LMMs) have made significant strides in multimodal retrieval, they primarily focus on global-level tasks and struggle to capture effective region-level representations. To bridge this gap, we present RegRet, an LMM-based Region-level Retrieval framework that enhances the regional representations without compromising overall global retrieval performance. At its core, RegRet integrates a Region-Aware Encoder to capture detailed regional features while balancing them with the global background context. To further enhance the fine-grained understanding and discriminability of representations, we design a multi-stage training pipeline that includes detailed localized captioning and regional contrastive learning tasks. In addition, considering the absence of region-level contrastive training data and the limited diversity of evaluation tasks in current benchmarks, we introduce the REGMB benchmark. It comprises 225k contrastive pairs, covering four multimodal retrieval tasks. Extensive experiments validate the effectiveness of our approach. RegRet outperforms strong baselines in the zero-shot setting. Further training with contrastive learning leads to an average improvement of more than 20\% on both REGMB and public benchmarks, while achieving comparable or better results on global-level retrieval tasks.
2609.16847.paper_summary_zh: 區域級檢索旨在將用戶指定的圖像區域與相關區域或文本描述對齊，這在電子商務產品搜索和RAG等現實世界應用中扮演著至關重要的角色。儘管最近的大型多模態模型（LMMs）在多模態檢索方面取得了顯著進展，但它們主要集中於全球級任務，並難以捕捉有效的區域級表示。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了RegRet，一個基於LMM的區域級檢索框架，旨在增強區域表示而不損害整體全球檢索性能。RegRet的核心整合了一個區域感知編碼器，以捕捉詳細的區域特徵，同時平衡全球背景上下文。為了進一步增強表示的細粒度理解和可辨識性，我們設計了一個多階段訓練流程，包括詳細的局部標題生成和區域對比學習任務。此外，考慮到當前基準中缺乏區域級對比訓練數據以及評估任務的多樣性有限，我們引入了REGMB基準。該基準包含225k對比對，涵蓋四個多模態檢索任務。大量實驗驗證了我們方法的有效性。RegRet在零樣本設置中超越了強基準。進一步的對比學習訓練使REGMB和公共基準的平均提升超過20\%，同時在全球級檢索任務中達到可比或更好的結果。
